name: GMX
description: GMX is a leading onchain exchange for perpetual and spot trading, offering deep liquidity, low fees, multi-chain support, and seamless one-click trading. Powered by isolated and multi-asset pools, the permissionless DEX enables anybody to provide liquidity and integrates with 80+ DeFi projects across Arbitrum, Avalanche, and Solana.

methodology.UserFees: Fees from open/close position (0.1%), swap (0.2% to 0.8%) and borrow fee ((assets borrowed)/(total assets in pool)*0.01%)
methodology.Fees: Fees from open/close position (0.1%), swap (0.2% to 0.8%), mint and burn (based on tokens balance in the pool) and borrow fee ((assets borrowed)/(total assets in pool)*0.01%)
methodology.Revenue: Revenue is 30% of all collected fees, which goes to GMX stakers
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 30% of all collected fees goes to GMX stakers
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 70% of all collected fees goes to GLP holders

Fees.Mint/Redeem Fees: Fees from mint and burn (based on tokens balance in the pool)
Fees.Margin Fees: Fees from open/close position (0.1%), and borrow fee ((assets borrowed)/(total assets in pool)*0.01%)

UserFees.Margin Fees: Fees from open/close position (0.1%), and borrow fee ((assets borrowed)/(total assets in pool)*0.01%)

SupplySideRevenue.Mint/Redeem Fees: 70% of revenue from mint/redeem fees to GLP
SupplySideRevenue.Margin Fees: 70% of revenue from margin fees to GLP
SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees: 70% of revenue from tokens swap fees to GLP

HoldersRevenue.Mint/Redeem Fees: 30% of revenue from mint/redeem fees to GMX stakers
HoldersRevenue.Margin Fees: 30% of revenue from margin fees to GMX stakers
HoldersRevenue.Token Swap Fees: 30% of revenue from tokens swap fees to GMX stakers

methodology.UserFees: Fees from opening/closing perpetual positions, swap fees, and liquidation fees paid by traders
methodology.Fees: Fees from opening/closing perpetual positions, borrowing fees, swap fees, liquidation fees, and positive price impact distributed from the impact pool, decoded from EventEmitter logs
methodology.Revenue: 37% of position fees (after referral rebates) and of borrowing, liquidation and swap fees, split between protocol treasury (10%) and GMX token holders (27%); distributed price impact goes to liquidity providers instead
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 10% of position fees (after referral rebates) and of borrowing, liquidation and swap fees goes to the protocol treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 27% of position fees (after referral rebates) and of borrowing, liquidation and swap fees goes to GMX token stakers
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 63% of position fees (after referral rebates) and of borrowing, liquidation and swap fees, plus all distributed price impact, goes to GM token liquidity providers; referral discounts and affiliate rewards go to traders and affiliates

Fees.Margin Fees: Fees from opening/closing perpetual positions and borrowing fees charged to maintain leveraged positions
Fees.Token Swap Fees: Fees charged when swapping tokens through GMX v2 markets
Fees.Liquidation Fees: Fees collected when positions are liquidated due to insufficient collateral
Fees.Price Impact: Positive price impact distributed from the position impact pool to the market pool, in index token

Revenue.Margin Fees: 37% of margin fees (after referral rebates) and borrowing fees retained by protocol
Revenue.Token Swap Fees: 37% of swap fees retained by protocol
Revenue.Liquidation Fees: 37% of liquidation fees retained by protocol

ProtocolRevenue.Margin Fees: 10% of margin fees (after referral rebates) and borrowing fees to protocol treasury
ProtocolRevenue.Token Swap Fees: 10% of swap fees to protocol treasury
ProtocolRevenue.Liquidation Fees: 10% of liquidation fees to protocol treasury

HoldersRevenue.Margin Fees: 27% of margin fees (after referral rebates) and borrowing fees distributed to GMX token stakers
HoldersRevenue.Token Swap Fees: 27% of swap fees distributed to GMX token stakers
HoldersRevenue.Liquidation Fees: 27% of liquidation fees distributed to GMX token stakers

SupplySideRevenue.Margin Fees: 63% of margin fees (after referral rebates) and borrowing fees distributed to GM token liquidity providers
SupplySideRevenue.Referral Rebates: Referral discounts to traders and rewards to affiliates, paid out of position fees before the protocol's 37% (positionFeeAmount - protocolFeeAmount)
SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees: 63% of swap fees distributed to GM token liquidity providers
SupplySideRevenue.Liquidation Fees: 63% of liquidation fees distributed to GM token liquidity providers
SupplySideRevenue.Price Impact: All distributed price impact to GM token liquidity providers

methodology.Fees: Opening/closing fees for perpetual positions, swap fees, liquidation fees, and borrowing fees
methodology.Revenue: 99% of all collected fees since 28 September 2026 (GT Buyback Season 2), 25% from 16 January 2026, 70% before.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Share of fees kept by the treasury after the GT buyback: 70% before 14 March 2025, 70% minus the actual GT buyback on 14-15 March 2025, 34% from 16 March 2025 to 15 January 2026, 25% from 16 January 2026, and since 28 September 2026 (GT Buyback Season 2) the part of the 99% not used for the GT buyback.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Daily GT buyback funded by the treasury: 36% of fees from 16 March 2025 to 15 January 2026 (actual amounts on the 14-15 March 2025 launch days), 0 before that and from 16 January 2026, and since 28 September 2026 (GT Buyback Season 2) the GT sold to the treasury that day at the GT minting cost, capped at 99% of fees. GT is GMTrade's own token, not GMX.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 1% of the fees go to liquidity providers since 28 September 2026 (GT Buyback Season 2), 75% from 16 January 2026, 30% before.

Fees.Trading Fees: Fees from opening/closing perpetual positions + borrowing fees + liquidation fees

Revenue.Trading Fees: 99% of the trading fees go to the protocol since 28 September 2026 (GT Buyback Season 2), 25% from 16 January 2026, 70% before.
Revenue.Token Swap Fees: 99% of the swap fees go to the protocol since 28 September 2026 (GT Buyback Season 2), 25% from 16 January 2026, 70% before.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees: Protocol share of fees kept by the treasury: 70% before 14 March 2025, 70% minus the actual GT buyback on 14-15 March 2025, 34% from 16 March 2025 to 15 January 2026, 25% from 16 January 2026, and since 28 September 2026 (GT Buyback Season 2) the part of the 99% not used for the GT buyback.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: Daily GT buyback funded by the treasury: 36% of fees from 16 March 2025 to 15 January 2026, the actual capped amounts on the 14-15 March 2025 launch days, 0 from 16 January 2026, and since 28 September 2026 (GT Buyback Season 2) the GT sold to the treasury that day at the GT minting cost, capped at 99% of fees.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees: 1% of the trading fees go to liquidity providers since 28 September 2026 (GT Buyback Season 2), 75% from 16 January 2026, 30% before.
SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees: 1% of the swap fees go to liquidity providers since 28 September 2026 (GT Buyback Season 2), 75% from 16 January 2026, 30% before.
